answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral to participate in network consensus. Beyond the technical horizon, this economic stake forces an attacker to endure a gale of financial depreciation if they attempt to manipulate the ledger. By linking identity to immutable holdings rather than ephemeral compute, the mechanism ensures that creating fake personas remains as costly as mining low-yield shale, thereby disincentivizing illicit network scale.
